"You can be disappointed without deciding you are hopeless."
"I asked you to make the work better, not to punish yourself."
"A mistake is something you made. It is not everything you are."
"If you knew how to do it perfectly already, you would not need a mentor."
"You have the right to ask a question before the work goes wrong."
"You noticed the error. That means you are learning to see."
"I would rather hear an honest failure than a beautiful excuse."
"Do not confuse being frightened with being unprepared."
"Your hands are shaking because this matters to you. Now give them a rest."
"The work is unfinished. That does not mean your future is."
"I can teach you to repair a mistake. I cannot teach you if you hide it."
"You are allowed to take pride in the parts you did well."
"The others are watching the lesson, not judging your whole life."
"I have ruined more projects than you have even attempted. That is how I learned."
"Tomorrow we will try again, and tomorrow I expect you to speak kindly to yourself."
"You listened to every criticism except the one that mattered: you needed rest."
"One day you will teach someone who is as frightened as you are now. Remember this."
"A careful worker knows when to begin again. A wise worker knows when to stop."
"You can respect the ancestors without pretending to know what they meant."
"An unanswered question is not a personal failure."
"Even the oldest scriptures have passages we still debate."
"You were so afraid of being wrong that you stopped listening."
"A respectful doubt is worth more than a confident guess."
"You do not have to settle three centuries of argument in one afternoon."

"You are allowed to ask what a symbol means before you explain it."

"You listened to everyone except yourself."
